records.title: DOC-032 compat compat-b manual-signing V-C17-manual legal_team_member 1790579729996
DOC-032 compat compat-b manual-signing V-C17-manual administrator 1790579729996

steps.action: Prerequisite: an unarchived Contract owned by the actor, with Business User Karim Aziz on the team; the lab has no Signing connector
steps.expected: The Contract exists in Draft; the lab reports Signing unconfigured
steps.actual: C-62 "DOC-032 compat compat-b manual-signing V-C17-manual legal_team_member 1790579729996" (MSA) created by Nadia Haddad; Status Draft; Karim Aziz added to the team. lab.json seed.signing = "unconfigured".

steps.action: Hand off step 1: use the Stage control to choose the Signature Status Out for signature
steps.expected: The Contract moves to Out for signature; with no Signing connector there is no Send for signature control and no Envelope
steps.actual: Check did not complete: locator.waitFor: Timeout 30000ms exceeded. Call log:   - waiting for getByRole('region', { name: 'Approvals & signing' }) to be visible

steps.action: Hand off step 2: open Documents; no Document yet, so Upload the first Document; then on it use Add version to upload the executed file with Type Executed
steps.expected: The first upload makes one Document; Add version adds v2 on the same chain with the Executed type
steps.actual: Upload document: Type started on "No type"; the draft filed as Document "doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-draft.pdf" (1 Document). Actions -> Add version: Type offered "No type, Draft · ours, Draft · theirs, Redline · theirs, Redline · ours, Partially signed, Executed, Amendment"; chose Executed and uploaded doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-executed.pdf. Read-back: 2 Versions on the same Document; v2 type Executed (kind executed); the row's Type column reads "Executed".

steps.action: Hand off step 3: read or download the uploaded Document Version and check that it is the executed copy
steps.expected: The reader opens the current Version and Download returns the exact uploaded bytes
steps.actual: Selecting "doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-draft.pdf" opened the reader "doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-draft.pdf, version 2"; the executed text did not render within 60 s. Download saved doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-executed.pdf with SHA-256 equal to the uploaded executed file (a1629cda27a87cb5...).

steps.action: Negative: choosing the Executed type during upload does not set the executed designation
steps.expected: No Version carries the executed designation; the Version cell shows no Executed mark
steps.actual: Read-back isExecuted for v1/v2: v1=false, v2=false. The Version cell reads "v2" with no Executed mark while the Type column reads Executed.

steps.action: Hand off step 4: open the Document's actions, select Mark as executed copy, check the designation; with several Documents, check the contract paper is the primary Document
steps.expected: v2 carries the executed designation; the Status does not change; after a second Document is uploaded the paper keeps Primary
steps.actual: Actions for doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-draft.pdf offered "Compare with previous, Mark as executed copy, Add version, Edit details, Move to folder, Mark confidential, Archive"; Mark as executed copy set the designation on v2 (v1=false, v2=true); the Version cell reads "v2 Executed". After a second Document "doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-schedule.pdf" was uploaded, the rows read "doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-draft.pdf Primary" and "doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-schedule.pdf": the contract paper keeps Primary. Status still Out for signature.

steps.action: Correct the wrong selection: Add version for a new round keeps the chain and the earlier signed Version keeps the designation; mark the correct Version (replaces the designation); then use the earlier Version's own actions to Unmark and Mark again
steps.expected: v3 becomes current while v2 stays designated; marking v3 moves the designation; v2's own actions offer Unmark as executed copy / Mark as executed copy
steps.actual: Add version filed doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-later.pdf as v3 on the same Document: v3 current, v2 still designated. Mark as executed copy on the Document moved the designation to v3 (one designation per chain). "Show the 2 earlier versions" -> v2's actions offered "Compare with previous, Mark as executed copy"; Mark as executed copy moved it back to v2; then "Compare with previous, Unmark as executed copy" -> Unmark cleared it; then "Compare with previous, Mark as executed copy" -> Mark restored it. Version cells: head "v3", earlier v2 "v2 Executed". v2 still downloads the executed bytes.

steps.action: Hand off step 5: use the Stage control to choose the intended Active Status; confirm a Soft gate override only if appropriate; check the Status and Activity
steps.expected: The Contract reaches Active without a connector; History records the executed designation and the Status change; no Envelope row exists
steps.actual: Stage control moved C-62 to Active (no Soft gate opened (no approvals)). Stage control reads "Active"; read-back Active/active. History: "Nadia Haddad changed the status Out for signature → Active this minute Nadia Haddad pinned version 2 of doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-draft.pdf as the executed copy this minute Nadia Haddad cleared the executed copy of doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-draft.pdf this minute Nadia Haddad pinned version 2 of doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-draft.pdf as the executed copy this minute Nadia Haddad pinned version 3 of d". Envelopes: 0.

steps.action: Negative: a Business User on the team cannot perform the legal action; an archived record offers no legal actions and refuses the designation; after Restore the designation is unchanged
steps.expected: Karim Aziz sees no executed-copy control and the API refuses his write; the archived Contract shows no Document action menus and refuses a clear; v2 stays designated
steps.actual: Karim Aziz in the Portal saw "Your Contracts DOC-032 compat compat-b manual-signing V-C17-manual legal_team_member 1790579729996 C-62 Overview Counterparty Not recorded S" with 0 executed-copy controls; his direct designation of v3 answered 403. Archived C-62 showed 0 "Actions for doc032-compatb-legal_team_member-draft.pdf" menus; clearing the designation answered 409. Restore answered 200; v2 is still designated.
